title: NormalizedStream
description: Output of normalize_capture.py: a mapper-neutral, press-paired event stream from one lane capture. This is the form the comparator diffs. Produced from an evdev or xi2 capture JSONL.

n_raw.description: Count of raw events before normalization (SYN dropped; Raw/Device dedup applied for xi2)

t0_epoch.description: Epoch timestamp of the first event (null if n_raw==0)

events.description: Normalized events, sorted by t_ms. Key/button events are press-paired (one record per press with dur_ms); REL events are individual with a value.

presses.description: Canonical-name -> count of completed press records

name.description: Canonical name: SPACE, F9, MOUSE_LEFT, MOUSE_DX, W, … (mapper-neutral)

t_ms.description: Milliseconds since t0_epoch (first event in the stream)

dur_ms.description: Press duration in ms for key/button/mousebtn events; null if up-only or still-held-at-end

value.description: REL event sample value (non-null for kind==rel only)

note.description: Anomaly annotation: up-only (no down seen), still-held-at-end, noise-stimulus-gap (output outside any stimulus window), deduped-raw (Raw event removed as duplicate of Device event)
